title: Decision: the coding-job contract
goal: The job inputs, outputs and limits are written down
acceptance: A decision in docs/decisions names the repository allowlist, worktree location, sandbox class, coding agent, budget, and what reaches the owner before a push

The decision measures the instruction load (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, procedures read at start) in tokens with the model's own counter, and refuses a model route whose context cannot hold the rules plus the task with room to work
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A change of gate class, data leaving the base, or a material effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-14 from the owner jobs case study, before design. Not a measurement.
